name: lone-cr-separates-lines
note: CommonMark counts a lone carriage return as a line ending, so this is two tasks and not one unparseable line. Before issue #33 the two implementations disagreed here: Java's regex $ also matches before a trailing line terminator and JavaScript's does not, so one side saw a checkbox and the other did not. Both were wrong; normalising all three line endings before the split is what fixed it.
